create_hf_dataset_repo: create a HuggingFace dataset repo with optional private or gated settings using the HfApi
create_unique_repo_name: create a unique timestamped repo name from a prefix and user string
cleanup_repo_fixture: use the cleanup_repo pytest fixture to delete a HuggingFace dataset repo by id
temporary_repo_fixture: use the temporary_repo context manager fixture to auto-cleanup a dataset repo after a test
hf_api_fixture: use the hf_api pytest fixture to get an HfApi client pointing to the CI Hub endpoint
